source: Original merged Meshy model before skin-weight refinement

method.region: 0.81 < local Y < 1.23 and abs(local X) < 0.29, smooth fade at region borders
method.spatialSmoothing: Triangle-area-weighted Gaussian averaging on unique positions; sigma 0.0175, radius 0.05 in model units
method.centralChest: Up to 80% arm weight reduction in central chest, smoothly tapering across lateral ribcage; removed weight distributed proportionally to non-arm influences
method.format: Four strongest influences normalized; unaffected vertices copied exactly

diagnosis.primaryCause: Coarse spatially discontinuous arm/chest skin weights, accentuated by extreme shoulder rotation. Not UV seam separation.

visualReview.observed: Original maximum wave and cheer show continuous gold lapels and clean shoulder outlines after refinement; central shirt and bow tie retain shape. No head, hand, leg, or foot deformation changes.
visualReview.limitations: Some residual edge stretch remains at extreme shoulder rotations; lower-amplitude gestures further reduce it. No geometry retopology was performed.
